subject: Post-call: SummitCo trial — prompt bundle & eval plan (next steps)
messages:
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 15:12:00 -0700
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Emily Park <emily.park@summitco.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Subject: Post-call: SummitCo trial — prompt bundle & eval plan (next steps)

Hi Emily,

Thanks again for the call today — great conversation and very aligned goals. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a shared plan for the trial: 

Summary of objectives
- Baseline quality: match or exceed SummitCo's current rule-based assistant for user satisfaction on 3 target flows (billing, onboarding, troubleshooting).
- Latency & cost target: median response < 600ms and cost < $0.004/response for 95th percentile load profile.
- No data exfiltration; all logs remain in your tenant for the Private trial.

Success criteria (what we'll measure)
1) NPS-style quality: 80%+ useful/acceptable across sampled prompts (we'll provide an evaluation form).
2) Regression check: top-1 intent accuracy >= current baseline.
3) Token-cost and median latency thresholds above.

Evaluation plan & timeline (proposed)
- 5/18: kickoff + prompt/log handoff (you) — please share the prompt bundle and 7 days of anonymized chat logs.
- 5/21: Redwood ingests prompts/logs and runs baseline sampling.
- 5/24: First evaluation report (qualitative samples + metrics).
- 5/28: Final trial report and recommendations (model variant, quantization, batching).

Ownership
- SummitCo: provide prompt bundle (CSV or JSONL), sample logs (anonymized), and any success criteria tweaks.
- Redwood: Ben will own model setup & eval runs; Marissa will own onboarding/CS checkpoints; I will own overall trial delivery and pricing/rollout recs.

File format & examples (short):
- Prompt bundle: CSV with columns [prompt_id, prompt_text, flow, expected_behavior (optional)].
- Chat logs: JSONL with fields [conversation_id, timestamp_utc, role (user/assistant), message_text] — PII redaction is fine; we just need realistic user phrasing.

Attachments: I attached a simple trial-eval-metrics-template.xlsx to make the metrics we’ll report explicit.

Asks for you this week
1) Share prompt bundle and 7 days of anonymized logs (CSV/JSONL) by EOD 5/20 if possible.
2) Confirm any additional success criteria or stakeholders to loop in (legal/security for Private trial).

If you prefer, we can also provide an SFTP/secure upload link; let me know what works.

Thanks — excited to get started.

Best,
Jordan
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0189

From: Emily Park <emily.park@summitco.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: ai@summitco.com
Subject: Re: Post-call: SummitCo trial — prompt bundle & eval plan (next steps)

Thanks Jordan — appreciate the clear write-up. Quick answers/notes: 

- We can share a prompt bundle and 10 days of chat logs (anonymized). We have two files ready: summitco_prompt_samples.csv (sample prompts) and chat-logs-202604.jsonl (April logs). Will attach a more complete export by EOD 5/20.
- Security: we need confirmation that Redwood will only process logs within the Private trial environment and that logs won’t be used to train public models.
- Regarding formats: we can provide CSV for prompts and JSONL for logs. We’ll strip user PII; please confirm fields you require so we don’t over-redact.

Two quick asks from our side:
1) Can you confirm the evaluation rubric you’ll use for quality scoring? (a short template would help).
2) Do you have a preferred secure upload method? We prefer SFTP or a gated Drive folder.

Attaching the initial prompt sample file for your review (summitco_prompt_samples.csv) and an extract of logs (chat-logs-202604.jsonl).

Thanks — Emily
Emily Park
Director of AI & Automation | SummitCo
emily.park@summitco.com

Attachments: summitco_prompt_samples.csv, chat-logs-202604.jsonl
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 13:47:30 -0700
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Emily Park <emily.park@summitco.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Subject: Re: Post-call: SummitCo trial — prompt bundle & eval plan (next steps)

Appreciate that, Emily — and great, the attached samples look useful. Quick answers and concrete asks so Ben and the team can start ingesting tomorrow: 

Security confirmation
- We will run the trial inside a customer-isolated Private deployment (VPC) and will not use customer logs to train any public models. We can add a short Data Processing Addendum for the trial if legal wants it. Ben/Marissa — please flag if we need to loop in Security for an NDA or DPA.

Evaluation rubric (summary) — we’ll provide a one-page rubric but here’s the short version:
- Usefulness (0–3): 3 = fully resolves with minimal follow-up; 2 = partially useful; 1 = irrelevant; 0 = harmful/incorrect.
- Intent accuracy (binary): does predicted intent match expected intent?
- Latency (ms): server-side median and 95th percentile.
- Cost per response (tokens): estimated from tokenized outputs.

Prompt & log formatting (concrete)
- Prompts CSV: [prompt_id, prompt_text, flow (billing|onboarding|support), expected_behavior, sensitivity_flag].
- Logs JSONL: each line a JSON object with conversation_id, timestamp_utc (ISO), role, message_text. PII fields removed or replaced with tokens (e.g., <EMAIL>, <PHONE>).

Deliverables & owners
- By 5/21 EOD: Redwood ingests provided files and runs a baseline sampling (owner: Ben).
- By 5/24: Initial evaluation report with 50 labeled samples + metrics (owner: Ben).
- By 5/28: Final report + recommended model config and cost/lambda (owner: Jordan/Ben).

Upload options
- Preferred: secure Drive folder (we shared a gated folder link) or SFTP. If you prefer SFTP, please send credentials over an initial separate email to security@redwood.com.

Ben — can you confirm your staging image/variant (e.g., small-quantized-3b) and whether we need additional transforms for SummitCo conversational style?

Thanks all — once we have the full prompt bundle we’ll create an eval dataset and send a labeling template for your reviewers.

— Jordan
